data.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: vertical 2:3 Pinterest editorial image
Primary request: Create a beautiful, believable old-master-inspired food photograph whose quiet visual surprise is the exact compact pizza cutter from Image 1 resting beside a freshly cut pizza. It should feel like an editorial magazine still life, never an advertisement.
Input images: Image 1 is the sole product-truth reference. Preserve the cutter's distinctive ordinary six-inch scale, compact blue front motor-like housing, gray rear/top handle, one exposed round stainless-steel cutting wheel with center fastener, and broad gray lower guard/plate. It is a hand-held pizza wheel shaped like a miniature circular saw, not a powered saw and not a full-size construction tool.
Scene/backdrop: intimate dark wood table with a freshly baked round pizza missing one clean slice, rumpled natural linen, a few restrained ingredients such as tomatoes and basil, and a dark painterly background.
Subject: the exact blue-and-gray saw-shaped pizza wheel is fully visible at a natural six-inch scale, resting at the pizza's cut edge as if it just made the cut.
Style/medium: highly realistic editorial food photography with subtle Dutch-master still-life influence, honest material texture, not surreal illustration.
Composition/framing: vertical 2:3; pizza and cutter form one strong diagonal; cutter large enough to inspect but integrated naturally; clean silhouette; no empty headline zone and no template-like layout.
Lighting/mood: warm directional window or candlelike light, rich restrained shadows, appetizing but not glossy commercial styling.
Materials/textures: crisp crust, melted cheese, worn wood, wrinkled linen, matte blue and gray engineering plastic, real brushed stainless-steel wheel.
Text: none. Do not invent, render, or emphasize any lettering, logo, packaging, label, headline, badge, button, or call to action.
Constraints: product geometry and scale must remain faithful to Image 1; exactly one cutter; exactly one circular cutting wheel; keep the lower guard/plate and center fastener; the product must not be operating under power; product contact with the pizza must be physically plausible; food-safe editorial context; no people or hands; no deceptive extra features.
Avoid: a real construction saw, giant tool scale, extra blades, duplicated objects, blade teeth, power cords, batteries, sparks, sawdust, blood, weapons, gore, floating product, showroom packshot, ad copy, Pinterest template, watermark, pseudo text.
notes: Generated from the exact downloaded Amazon primary image.
The repository copy was inspected at full useful resolution.
